text: I'm just looking, thanks.
ipa: /aɪm dʒʌst ˈlʊkɪŋ θæŋks/
meaningVi: Tôi chỉ xem thôi, cảm ơn.
example: A: Can I help you find anything? — B: I'm just looking, thanks.

text: Can I try this on before I buy it?
ipa: /kæn aɪ traɪ ðɪs ɑːn bɪˈfɔːr aɪ baɪ ɪt/
meaningVi: Tôi mặc thử cái này trước khi mua được không?
example: A: Can I try this on before I buy it? — B: Sure, go ahead.

text: Excuse me, where are the fitting rooms?
ipa: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː wer ɑːr ðə ˈfɪtɪŋ ruːmz/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, phòng thử đồ ở đâu ạ?
example: A: Excuse me, where are the fitting rooms? — B: At the back, on the left.

text: It's a little too tight around the shoulders.
ipa: /ɪts ə ˈlɪtəl tuː taɪt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈʃoʊldərz/
meaningVi: Phần vai hơi chật quá.
example: A: How does the jacket fit? — B: It's a little too tight around the shoulders.

text: Do you have this in a bigger size?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ðɪs ɪn ə ˈbɪɡər saɪz/
meaningVi: Cái này có cỡ lớn hơn không?
example: A: Do you have this in a bigger size? — B: Let me check in the back.

text: Does this come in any other colors?
ipa: /dʌz ðɪs kʌm ɪn ˈeni ˈʌðər ˈkʌlərz/
meaningVi: Cái này có màu khác không?
example: A: Does this come in any other colors? — B: Yes, black and navy.

text: Sorry, how much is this one? I can't find the price tag.
ipa: /ˈsɑːri haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðɪs wʌn aɪ kænt faɪnd ðə praɪs tæɡ/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, cái này giá bao nhiêu? Tôi không thấy nhãn giá.
example: A: Sorry, how much is this one? I can't find the price tag. — B: That's twenty-five dollars.

text: Is this on sale, or is it full price?
ipa: /ɪz ðɪs ɑːn seɪl ɔːr ɪz ɪt fʊl praɪs/
meaningVi: Món này đang giảm giá hay vẫn giá gốc?
example: A: Is this on sale, or is it full price? — B: It's thirty percent off.

text: That's a bit too expensive for me.
ipa: /ðæts ə bɪt tuː ɪkˈspensɪv fər miː/
meaningVi: Cái đó hơi đắt so với tôi.
example: A: It's eighty dollars. — B: Hmm, that's a bit too expensive for me.

text: Can you give me a better price if I buy two?
ipa: /kæn juː ɡɪv miː ə ˈbetər praɪs ɪf aɪ baɪ tuː/
meaningVi: Nếu tôi mua hai cái thì bớt cho tôi được không?
example: A: Can you give me a better price if I buy two? — B: Okay, two for fifteen.

text: What's your best price for this bag?
ipa: /wʌts jʊr best praɪs fər ðɪs bæɡ/
meaningVi: Cái túi này bán thấp nhất là bao nhiêu?
example: A: What's your best price for this bag? — B: For you, ten dollars.

text: Okay, I'll take it.
ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ɪt/
meaningVi: Được, tôi lấy cái này.
example: A: It's the last one in your size. — B: Okay, I'll take it.

text: I think I'll leave it for now, thanks.
ipa: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪl liːv ɪt fər naʊ θæŋks/
meaningVi: Chắc tôi để lần sau vậy, cảm ơn.
example: A: Would you like to buy it? — B: I think I'll leave it for now, thanks.

text: Can I pay with my phone, or is it cash only?
ipa: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɪð maɪ foʊn ɔːr ɪz ɪt kæʃ ˈoʊnli/
meaningVi: Tôi trả bằng điện thoại được không, hay chỉ nhận tiền mặt?
example: A: Can I pay with my phone, or is it cash only? — B: You can scan this QR code.

text: Do you need a bag for that?
ipa: /də juː niːd ə bæɡ fər ðæt/
meaningVi: Anh/chị có cần túi đựng không?
example: A: Do you need a bag for that? — B: No thanks, I'll just carry it.

text: Could I get a receipt, please?
ipa: /kʊd aɪ ɡet ə rɪˈsiːt pliːz/
meaningVi: Cho tôi xin biên lai được không?
example: A: Here's your change. — B: Thanks. Could I get a receipt, please?

text: I'd like to return this. It doesn't fit me.
ipa: /aɪd laɪk tə rɪˈtɜːrn ðɪs ɪt ˈdʌzənt fɪt miː/
meaningVi: Tôi muốn trả lại món này. Nó không vừa với tôi.
example: A: I'd like to return this. It doesn't fit me. — B: No problem. Do you want a refund?

text: Can I exchange it for a different size?
ipa: /kæn aɪ ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ɪt fər ə ˈdɪfrənt saɪz/
meaningVi: Tôi đổi sang cỡ khác được không?
example: A: Can I exchange it for a different size? — B: Sure, as long as you haven't worn it.

text: Do you still have the receipt with you?
ipa: /də juː stɪl hæv ðə rɪˈsiːt wɪð juː/
meaningVi: Anh/chị còn giữ hóa đơn mua hàng không?
example: A: I want a refund for these shoes. — B: Do you still have the receipt with you?

text: What time do you close tonight?
ipa: /wʌt taɪm də juː kloʊz təˈnaɪt/
meaningVi: Tối nay mấy giờ cửa hàng đóng cửa?
example: A: What time do you close tonight? — B: At ten o'clock.

text: I'm looking for a gift for my mom.
ipa: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ fər ə ɡɪft fər maɪ mɑːm/
meaningVi: Tôi đang tìm quà tặng mẹ.
example: A: I'm looking for a gift for my mom. — B: How about this scarf?

text: Be honest, does this look okay on me?
ipa: /bi ˈɑːnɪst dʌz ðɪs lʊk oʊˈkeɪ ɑːn miː/
meaningVi: Nói thật đi, tôi mặc cái này có ổn không?
example: A: Be honest, does this look okay on me? — B: It looks great, actually!

text: Does this come with a warranty?
ipa: /dʌz ðɪs kʌm wɪð ə ˈwɔːrənti/
meaningVi: Cái này có bảo hành không?
example: A: Does this come with a warranty? — B: Yes, one year.

text: Could you wrap it up as a gift, please?
ipa: /kʊd juː ræp ɪt ʌp æz ə ɡɪft pliːz/
meaningVi: Gói quà giúp tôi được không?
example: A: Could you wrap it up as a gift, please? — B: Of course. It's free.

text: Excuse me, which floor is the shoe section on?
ipa: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː wɪtʃ flɔːr ɪz ðə ʃuː ˈsekʃən ɑːn/
meaningVi: Xin lỗi, quầy giày ở tầng mấy?
example: A: Excuse me, which floor is the shoe section on? — B: The third floor.
